title: ObjectForge embodied operational validation

required: validated Scope 5 manufacturing and service plan

completion_gates: every critical deploy, operate, stow, and closure task has at least one valid actor route
human routes cover every retained operational task
mobile-manipulator routes cover multiple bounded tasks
all analytical load cases remain within declared capacities
every deterministic injected failure has detection, a safe state, and a recovery route

no external finished-model or simulation provider supplies the evidence
